# Hanzo Network

> AI compute, proved and paid. Developers run AI on the network; anyone with GPUs or CPUs earns by doing that work; every job is proved before anyone is paid (Proof of AI).

## For developers
An OpenAI-compatible API at api.hanzo.ai serves Hanzo's Zen models and leading models from other labs. Every job is provable. Get an API key at https://platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys.

## For compute providers
Keep the customer fee and earn AI rewards when your work is proved. Proofs are CPU-verifiable. Payout goes to any supported chain. Run a node (https://github.com/hanzoai/node) or apply at https://hanzo.ai/contact.

## How a job runs
1. Admit: the job and its reward are fixed on A-Chain before it runs.
2. Execute: a provider runs it and commits the exact output.
3. Validate: ordinary CPUs check the work; TEEs are optional for private jobs.
4. Settle: the receipt is rolled up on Z-Chain and paid on any chain via Lux.
